Industrial facilities in the city of Syzran, in Russia's Samara region, came under Ukrainian drone attack overnight, the city's mayor said on Wednesday.

In a statement on Russia's Facebook equivalent, VKontakte, Andrei Sovetkin did not name the facilities attacked in the city, which hosts an oil refinery which Ukraine has repeatedly struck in recent years. https://t.co/WHvflMJafl

Equinor and JAPEX have signed two transactions on the Norwegian continental shelf. Equinor will increase its ownership in the Equinor-operated Verdande field and receive a cash consideration of USD 65 million, while divesting part of its non-operated interest in Goliat.

The transactions will simplify the partnership structure in the Norne area and enable optimized value creation in late field life. #oott https://t.co/myqBQiYgU0

A record three-quarters of the global fleet of large tankers designed to transport oil products are tapping higher earnings to ship crude, keeping the cost to move fuels elevated.

Less than a quarter of the world’s 542 long-range 2, or LR2, tankers are currently transporting “clean” cargoes such as jet fuel, naphtha and diesel as of this week, according to Signal Ocean data. The vessels have cargo holds that are coated to transport refined fuels, and have to undergo an expensive cleaning process to return to the trade once they ship “dirty” crude oil.
